description: Look up one AI model id (for example gpt-4o-2024-05-13 or claude-sonnet-4-5) in apiwatch's reviewed feed of vendor changes before you use it in code. Returns a one line answer (when it stops working, changes behavior, or its deprecation key date) and each matching record with the date, what to do and the replacement, and links to the record and the vendor's source. "No record" means apiwatch has no record for it, not that it is safe. Records that apply only in some repos or files say so in scope.

model.description: The model id as it appears in code

name: check_model

date_passed.description: True when the key date is today or earlier (UTC)

scope.description: Empty when the record applies to every caller; otherwise where it applies

title: Check an AI model id
